content: On English$\Rightarrow $Chinese, content words are more important than content-free words, while the situation is reversed on both French$\Rightarrow $English and Japanese$\Rightarrow $English translations. Since there is no clear boundary between Preposition/Determiner and other categories in Japanese, we set both categories to be none. Similarly, Punctuation is more important on Japanese$\Rightarrow $English, which is in line with the finding on English$\Rightarrow $Japanese. Overall speaking, it might indicate that the Syntactic distribution with word importance is language-pair related instead of the direction.
